projects.name: Alborz data center
projects.quote: Alborz: All mining rigs have been installed at this 40 MW wind-powered site with Cipher’s joint venture partner, producing up to 1.3 EH/s;

projects.name: Bear data center
projects.quote: We completed our Alborz data center, mining rigs are en route to finalize the initial phases of the Bear and Chief data centers, and our 205 megawatt facility at Odessa is scheduled to deploy over the remainder of 2022,” said Tyler Page, CEO of Cipher.
